source-observations.purpose: Own provider source observations, review workflow, and promotion into canonical Catalog Items.
source-observations.allowedWhen: Required when external catalog providers can feed candidate Catalog facts.

authoring-support.purpose: Provide reusable authoring-support assets shared by catalog-owned features and composition seams.
authoring-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
authoring-support.justification: authoring-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
authoring-support.createdFor: catalog workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
authoring-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.
